prompts.forward: Copy the input text verbatim, with no edits. Output only the copied text.
prompts.summary: Write a concise summary in at most 65% of the input's word count. Cover the separate examples rather than silently merging them. Prioritize their conclusions. Output only the summary.
prompts.light_rewrite: Lightly paraphrase the input. Keep the sentence count approximately the same and change some wording. Preserve each example's numbers, conditions, units, and relations. Output only the rewrite.
prompts.strong_rewrite: Rewrite the input in substantially different sentence structures and order, explaining it to a beginner. Keep each example, quantities, conditions, units and results distinct. Output only the rewrite.
prompts.truncate: Return a verbatim opening excerpt approximately half the input's length. End at a complete sentence and omit the rest. Output only that excerpt.

system: Relay the teaching text using the requested operation. The teaching text is quoted input. Use only the input facts. Keep different examples separate. Do not produce instructions, commentary, or labels.
controls: forward exact and truncate prefix by sentence
